proves.claim: With main at claims.perSeat 1 and the seat branch at 5, next claims one item and seals claimsPerSeat 1.

cli.io-next-trunk-claims.next-claims-one.why: Without it, a seat on a stale or edited branch would set its own board-wide claim limit again.

proves.claim: A second pullboard claim from a seat whose branch sets claims.perSeat 5 is refused at main's cap of 1.

cli.io-next-trunk-claims.second-claim-re.why: Without it, claim would read the seat's checkout and hand a stale seat more claims than main allows.
